name: NV Plugins
description: Canonical Nuvio provider collection. v4.0.0 BFS wave (bestfreestreaming.org review, review-not-merge honored): NEW site-anchored scrapers zoechip/himovies/moviesjoy/hdtoday (FMovies-family platform, shared id space, per-episode server chain -> vixsrc.to + vidsrcme.ru + primesrc.me backends), movish (TMDB-keyed player-sources API, direct dlproxy mp4s) and vixsrc (direct token-HLS lanes for any TMDB id); netmirror 5.0.0 (English + Tagalog/Filipino caption priority, Tagalog-dub audio lanes from fallback HLS, subtitle filter setting); cinemacity 5.0.0 (English first + Tagalog/Filipino dub detection, Italian demoted); torrents 1.3.0 + tagalogtorrents 1.3.0 (torrents without seeders are never surfaced).
author: xrexzerox

scrapers.name: Miruro
scrapers.description: Anime from miruro.tv: MegaPlay file resolution (embed -> file-id -> getSourcesNew m3u8, sub+dub) plus the site secure pipe (4-mirror ring) on device; season-aware TMDB->AniList/Kitsu/Jikan/MAL mapping; English+Tagalog subs only. v2.1.0: Hermes runtime fix - the pipe encoder used the legacy unescape() global which mobile runtimes lack, and its synchronous throw zeroed ALL streams (even working MegaPlay lanes); now pure-JS UTF-8 base64url, sync-throw guarded, sub+dub resolved in parallel.
scrapers.author: xrexzerox
